title: College Basketball
description:
Oakland at Michigan
The Oakland Golden Grizzlies visit the Michigan Wolverines for an NCAA Division I game. The Golden Grizzlies feature point guard RJ Taylor, their primary playmaker, and the Wolverines feature guard Roddy Gayle Jr. in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

title: College Basketball
description:
FDU at Illinois
The Fairleigh Dickinson Knights play the Illinois Fighting Illini at State Farm Center for an NCAA Men's Basketball regular-season opener. Fairleigh Dickinson ended last season with a loss against Mercyhurst, while Illinois lost against Wisconsin.

title: College Basketball
description:
Montana at Oregon
The Montana Grizzlies visit the Oregon Ducks for an NCAA Division I college basketball game. The Montana Grizzlies feature guard Jalen Brown, and the Oregon Ducks showcase point guard Fred Payne at Matthew Knight Arena in Eugene, Oregon.
